abs_threshold_braking.definition: Braking at the limit of grip by pressing and releasing the pedal before the wheel locks.
abs_threshold_braking.example: Without ABS the driver has to use threshold braking.

cs_deflection.definition: Turning a question back on the person who asked it, so that the original question is never answered.
cs_deflection.example: The deflection worked once, and I still had not answered what was wrong with the drawing.

gem_accountability.definition: The answer you owe for an act, to the people affected and to the law.
gem_accountability.example: The mistake was hers, and the accountability was hers as well.

market_valuation.definition: The total price investors place on a company or sector, reflecting expected future profits rather than current ones.

psy_consent.definition: Everyone agreeing freely to something, every time. A clear no is a complete answer that needs no follow-up.
psy_consent.example: Consent has to be clear on both sides, and a no is always a complete answer.

tax_withholding.definition: Income tax taken out of your pay in advance by the employer. It is not your final tax bill.
tax_withholding.example: The tax withheld this month was higher because my bonus was large.

why.definition: The question word that asks for a reason. Why questions are the most interesting ones.
why.example: Why do we have to sleep?
